description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kosgoda, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620275
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and addresses, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
